headline: Second empty day in a row; minimal drift
body: Another quiet day with no scored events. The same gentle fade of older stories continued, and no line moved more than a few hundredths. The board still reflects the late-June mix of gated frontier models and alignment worries. Horizon Balance: +0.55.
movers_note: No ending moved by as much as 0.05 points (all 0.0 at one decimal); Reversion and Self-Destruction shifted most, by two hundredths, from fading contributions.
